attributes.action: Fair Government nation wide and not just any one region
attributes.additional_details: With the PM selecting his Cabinet and early policies it is striking clear that labour under him is only worried about promotion of the north west and governing for one specific region in one country and not for the whole UK as a whole. I hope this petition can get the attention to alert the government and make them aware that improving one region and favouring those voters over the whole of the UK and NI is unacceptable and stoking the north south divide not trying productively to heal it.
attributes.background: I feel that it is integral that the government should be more concerned and focused on protecting and improving life for all people in the UK and NI and not just picking certain regions or areas. As seen in the cabinet it shows the concentration of the north west and not thinking about the whole UK

rejection.details: You may wish to start a new petition setting out more clearly what you would like the government/parliament to do.
